issues.problem: Revenue rose from $26.91B to $26.97B, so growth is about 0.2%, not 4.1%.

data.summary: All figures are correct except the revenue growth rate, which is about 0.2%, not 4.1%. On EPS, $3.85 is fiscal 2022 before the split and $0.17 is fiscal 2023 after the 10-for-1 split. Fiscal 2023 EPS was $1.74 before the split, and fiscal 2022 was about $0.39 after it.
